_note: Each client has its own .catch→[] so a single rejection does NOT trip the error branch — only a throw INSIDE the .then (or the outer Promise.all rejecting before the per-client catch) sets s.error. The renderable error state shows `paymentsPage.loadError` = "Couldn't load payments: {error}". Isolate must force the .then/Promise.all to reject; the per-call _throw documents intent.
